TWO single seamless BLACK rectangles between upper/lower TRIPLE-pane window groups. Each triple group exactly THREE panes, never four. Wall immediately above entry doors below large window WHITE. Pale stone entry tower. Preserve shown sills only, updated garage roof facets. Material palette follows source: off-white fine brick, pale off-white natural stone, smooth Arctic White Hardie architectural panels with thin joints where drawn, black flat Hardie, existing white VERTICAL board-and-batten, charcoal asphalt shingles, black frames/doors/railings. BLACK gutters along every roof eave with narrow white fascia below. NO downspouts anywhere, do not invent vertical black pipes. NO horizontal lap siding. Bright soft daylight, realistic blue-sky window reflections, wispy clouds, distant trees low at sides behind building. Whole house large, straight on, wide~2.1:1, grade near bottom thin line, no broad foreground lawn/pavement. No text, people, vehicles, shrubs, watermark. Use only this v8 architecture.
